name: Audio-Technica Pro45
ref: Audio-Technica PRO 45 cardioid condenser hanging mic
what: A small mic that hangs upside down from the ceiling or a truss on its own cable. Picks up choirs, stage plays and groups from above, with no stands on stage. Condenser mics need phantom power (48V) from the mixer.
specs: Cardioid condenser; needs phantom power; hangs by its cable; XLR

name: Audio WorkBox
what: A stackable rolling case (Milwaukee PACKOUT) packed with small audio parts: adapters, tape, spare cables, tools. You grab one box and have everything for the job.
specs: Milwaukee PACKOUT modular stack on wheels
notes: PRICE NOT CONFIRMED: this is a custom-packed kit. The rolling base box alone (48-22-8426) is about $139.97-$249.

name: Audix D6 Microphone
ref: Audix D6 dynamic kick drum mic
what: The classic kick (bass) drum mic. Tuned to capture deep low end and the click of the beater. Also works on bass amps and floor toms.
specs: Dynamic; cardioid; built for low frequencies; XLR

name: Audix F90 Microphone
what: Tiny gooseneck mic that clips onto an instrument (horn bell, drum rim, percussion) so the musician can move and the mic stays in place.
specs: Cardioid condenser; clip mount + gooseneck; handles up to 135 dB

name: Baofeng Charging Station
what: Charges six walkie-talkies at once so the crew's radios are full before the show.

name: Baofeng UV-5R MK5 Walkie Talkie
what: Handheld walkie-talkie the crew uses to talk during load-in and the show (audio, lights and stage manager on the same channel).
notes: PRICE NOT CONFIRMED: listings vary a lot (single vs. kits).

name: Batteries
what: Batteries for wireless mic packs, in-ear packs and small gear. Pros put fresh batteries in wireless mics before every show.
notes: PRICE NOT CONFIRMED: mixed sizes. Priced per pack, not per item.

name: Behringer P1 Wired IEM Amplifier
what: A performer's personal headphone amp. Plug in a monitor mix (XLR) and in-ear headphones; the performer controls their own volume. Battery or USB powered.
specs: XLR/TRS input; headphone out; volume + balance; battery powered

name: Behringer Powerplay P2 In-Ear Monitor Amplifier
what: Ultra-small belt-pack version of the P1: one XLR monitor feed in, earphones out.
specs: XLR input; 3.5 mm headphone out; battery powered

name: Behringer S16 Stage Box
what: A digital snake. Mics plug in on stage and ONE network cable (AES50) carries all 16 channels to an X32 mixer, instead of a heavy copper snake.
specs: 16 Midas mic preamps in / 8 XLR out; AES50 network link
notes: Pairs with the X32 mixers below.

name: Behringer X32C Console
what: A digital mixer with motorized faders. Blends all mics and playback, adds EQ, compression and effects, and sends mixes to speakers and monitors.
specs: 40 input channels; 16 local mic preamps; 25 buses; 17 motorized faders; AES50

name: Behringer X32 Rack (Blossom)
what: The same X32 mixing engine in a rack box with no faders. You mix from a tablet or laptop, so the mixer can live side-stage.
specs: 40 input channels; 16 mic preamps; 3U rack; controlled by iPad/PC
notes: Your 3 X32 Racks are named after the Powerpuff Girls (Blossom, Bubbles, Buttercup).

name: Behringer X32 Rack (Bubbles)
what: Second X32 Rack (see Blossom).

name: Behringer X32 Rack (Buttercup)
what: Third X32 Rack (see Blossom).

name: Behringer Xenyx 1204USB Analog Mixer
what: A small analog (knobs, no screen) mixer for simple gigs: a few mics and music playback. USB lets you record to or play from a laptop.
specs: 12 inputs (4 mic preamps); 2 buses; USB audio

name: BESTEK 8-Outlet Surge Protector
ref: BESTEK 8-outlet tower with USB + wireless charger
what: A power tower with surge protection. Powers laptops, switchers and chargers at the tech table.
specs: 8 AC outlets; USB ports; wireless charger on top

name: BeyerDynamic M88 Microphone
what: A premium dynamic mic that's famous on kick drums and also used for vocals and guitar amps. Hypercardioid means very focused pickup that rejects sound from the sides.

name: BirdDog 3 X5 Ultra PTZ Camera
what: A robotic camera that Pans (left/right), Tilts (up/down) and Zooms by remote control. One operator can run several. Great for livestreams and conferences. Sends video over network (NDI) or SDI.
specs: 4K; 20x optical zoom; NDI HX3; 12G-SDI; AI tracking
notes: Inventory name '3 X5' likely means 3 cameras in the set.

name: BirdDog KBD PTZ Controller
what: The joystick desk for the PTZ cameras. Move, zoom and save preset shots, and preview up to 4 cameras on its screen.
specs: Joystick; built-in 1280x720 screen; controls PTZ cameras over network

name: Bistro Lighting WorkBox
what: PACKOUT stack packed with everything for a bistro-light install: extension cords, hooks, zip ties, spare bulbs.

name: Bistro String Lights (100 ft.)
ref: Commercial G40 LED globe string lights, 100 ft
what: Café-style globe bulbs on a cable, strung over patios and tents for warm ambience at outdoor events.

name: Bistro String Lights (50. ft)
ref: Commercial G40 LED globe string lights, 50 ft
what: 50 ft version of the bistro lights.

name: Black Area Rug (3.3 X 5 ft)
what: Stage rug: covers cables, stops mic stands and drums from sliding, and deadens foot noise.

name: Black Area Rug (4'6" X 6'7")
what: Larger stage rug (e.g. under a drum kit or a panel's chairs).

name: Blackmagic Design ATEM 2 M/E Constellation 4K Switcher
what: The big video mixer. It takes many camera and computer feeds and lets the director cut between them live. '2 M/E' = two mix/effect rows, so you can build two separate outputs (e.g. the screen and the stream).

name: Blackmagic Design ATEM Mini Pro Live Stream Switcher
what: A small desktop switcher: 4 HDMI inputs, big buttons to cut between them, and built-in streaming straight to YouTube, Facebook and similar. Perfect for small events.
specs: 4 HDMI in; streams over Ethernet; records to USB drive; multiview

name: Blackmagic Design ATEM Television Studio HD Video Switcher
what: All-in-one broadcast switcher with a built-in control panel: 8 inputs, cuts and transitions, and a multiview.
notes: Inventory name is cut off; the photo matches the HD8. Confirm HD8 vs. HD8 ISO ($3,995).

name: Blackmagic Design HyperDeck Studio 4K Pro
what: A rack recorder: records the switcher's program feed to SD cards/SSD, or plays back videos (walk-in loops, sponsor videos) into the show.

name: Blackmagic Design Micro Converter BiDirectional SDI/HDMI 12G
what: Converts SDI to HDMI AND HDMI to SDI at the same time. SDI is the pro video cable (BNC, locks, runs long distances); HDMI is the consumer one (TVs, laptops). 12G = handles 4K.
notes: Inventory name is cut off; photo shows the 12G version.

name: Blackmagic Design Micro Converter BiDirectional SDI/HDMI 3G
ref: Blackmagic Micro Converter BiDirectional SDI/HDMI 3G (with PSU)
what: Same idea as the 12G converter but for HD (1080p), not 4K. You own 16, so you'll use these constantly.
notes: Inventory name is cut off; photo shows the 3G version.

name: Blackmagic Design Power Supply for Micro Converters
what: Wall power adapter for the Micro Converters, with international plug heads.

name: Black Stage Skirt 15.5" X 10'
what: Pleated fabric that hangs around the edge of a stage riser to hide legs, cables and cases. Height matches the stage height (15.5" for a 16" stage).
specs: 15.5" tall x 10' long; black; shirred pleat

name: Black Stage Skirt 15.5" X 8'
ref: National Public Seating SS16-96 shirred stage skirt (15" x 96")
what: Stage skirt for an 8 ft stage edge on a 16" stage.
notes: Price seen for the navy version of the same model; confirm black.

name: Black Stage Skirt 23.5" X 10'
what: Stage skirt for a 24" stage, 10 ft edge.

name: Black Stage Skirt 23.5" X 8'
ref: National Public Seating SS24-96 shirred stage skirt
what: Stage skirt for a 24" stage, 8 ft edge.

name: Blue Tarp
what: Waterproof cover for gear and cable runs when it rains at outdoor events.

name: BNC Cable (1 ft.)
what: BNC is the twist-lock connector used for SDI video. A 1 ft cable jumps between two boxes in the same rack.
notes: Your inventory files this under Audio, but BNC/SDI is video, so it's moved to Video here. PRICE NOT CONFIRMED.

name: BNC Cable (25 ft.)
what: Carries SDI video from a camera or converter to the switcher. SDI runs much farther than HDMI and locks in place.
notes: Your inventory files this under Audio, but it's video, so it's moved to Video here.

name: Boom Tie Off
ref: City Theatrical boom tie-off for 1-1/2" pipe (#1310)
what: A cap with a steel loop that screws on top of a light boom (pipe). You tie a safety line from it to the wall or truss so the boom can't tip over.

name: Brown Tarp
what: Heavy-duty cover for gear, or to protect floors and grass.
